title: Rookie LB Red Murdock is anything but Irrelevant and gives the Broncos a tackling and fumble forcing machine

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rookie LB Red Murdock is anything but Irrelevant and gives the Broncos a tackling and fumble forcing machine
sources.description: With the final pick in the 2026 NFL Draft, or more commonly known as Mr. Irrelevant, the Denver Broncos selected linebacker Red Murdock. Murdock is a 6-1, 232-pound linebacker who is known for his big hits and causing turnovers. In three seasons, he forced an impressive 17 forced fumbles and was a tackling machine for […]
